propositions: MCP transition_ticket and claim_ticket handwritten signatures omit force, reason, caused_by, and ref parameters that are supported by the library and CLI.
FastMCP derives JSON schemas from the registered callable signatures and discards undeclared payload keys before the adapter runs.
The MCP adapter layer forwards only close_class for transition and assignee for claim, so signature changes alone do not propagate missing parameters to the library core.

transition_ticket must expose force as str | None, caused_by, and ref; claim_ticket must expose force as str | None, with both mapping to the unified library force parameter that carries reason or None.
MCP ref and caused_by must reach the shared library core unchanged so that ref targets the requested commit for verification/signing and caused_by writes the culprit edge.
